name: Minamimaki (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Minamimaki village emblem in red and white: a red disc with a white stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Minamimaki, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Minamimaki village emblem — a red disc with a white stylised character of horizontal strokes
